description: piigate: gate (denies direct reads of sensitive sources and unfiltered tools on them), output filter (mail MCP — pseudonyms; PESEL/account/card sensors in Bash/Read/Grep and unfiltered MCP tools) and a ~/.local/bin/piigate symlink to the current version (SessionStart). MCP tools are matched broadly; the hook returns at once, without output, for MCP tools not named in the configuration (mail_mcp, unfiltered_tools).
